findings.title: Derivation records the input profile digest but rewrites the bundled profile bytes
findings.evidence: tools/qore.py:215,235; profile-identities.json; commands.json old-compact-derive and old-compact-check-review
findings.counterexample: Using cases/old-compact-profile.json, original derive and verify exit 0, but release profile SHA-256 is 63c9157e3dd4d6eb2c33c899820422e8ce1d1bee9cc4e22c1df96d814e50a83f while all three bundled profiles and checker identities are da03026c9f73a7771cc35aaaff898a3b970fed75362ebfd0c670068d6b23b3d9. Expected released identity to match consumed bytes. Fixed compact derivation preserves the input bytes and all identities agree. Pretty-profile control agrees on both targets.
findings.correction_scope: The original defect remains confirmed; FIXED describes only the proposed revision on exercised boundaries.

findings.title: Unchanged failing gates bypass the promised three-comparison plateau stop
findings.counterexample: cases/stop-constant3-4.json measures G1=3 at n=1..4. Original exits 0 with CHANGE_APPROACH and no_improve_count=3; expected STOP_PLATEAU after three non-improving comparisons under protocol.md. Fixed returns STOP_PLATEAU / DO-NOT-SHIP. At n=3 CHANGE_APPROACH remains correct; zeros stop at plateau and n=6/7 stop at ceiling.
findings.correction_scope: The original defect remains confirmed; FIXED describes only the proposed revision on exercised boundaries.

findings.title: Spec validation counts literal docstring text as executable acceptance steps
findings.counterexample: cases/spec-docstring-quote.md has one executable Given; its only When/Then are docstring payload. Original public shell entry exits 0 valid:true; expected rejection under specification.md. Fixed exits 1 with missing when/then. Backtick docstrings reproduce too. Original accepts outline-missing and outline-header; fixed rejects both. Executable scenarios and populated/empty-value Examples controls pass.
findings.correction_scope: The original defect remains confirmed; FIXED describes only the proposed revision on exercised boundaries.

findings.title: Inherited object properties can satisfy missing UX measurements
findings.counterexample: cases/stop-missing-toString.json declares toString and no scores or measurements. Original exits 0 SHIP / COMPLETE with missing_gates:[]; expected rejection or missing observation, never SHIP. Fixed exits 2 for unsupported gate. constructor, __proto__, and hasOwnProperty are also rejected. All eight supported gates are PARTIAL when missing and SHIP with measured score 5.
findings.correction_scope: The original defect remains confirmed; FIXED describes only the proposed revision on exercised boundaries.

findings.title: Derived release profile identity hashes the input bytes rather than the bundled profile
findings.counterexample: Same independently reproduced defect as C-001: compact input digest 63c9157e3dd4d6eb2c33c899820422e8ce1d1bee9cc4e22c1df96d814e50a83f differs from original bundled/checker digest da03026c9f73a7771cc35aaaff898a3b970fed75362ebfd0c670068d6b23b3d9 despite successful derive and verify. Expected identical released/consumed identity; fixed input, top manifest, three local manifests, three bundles, and checkers agree.
findings.correction_scope: The original defect remains confirmed; FIXED describes only the proposed revision on exercised boundaries.

findings.title: Findings gate accepts CONFIRMED lower-severity findings without the required counterexample
findings.counterexample: cases/finding-medium-missing.json declares medium CONFIRMED without counterexample. Original exits 0 valid:true / COMPLETE / SHIP; expected invalid because every CONFIRMED finding needs concrete counterexample support. Fixed exits 1 INVALID. Original also accepts low/info missing, blank, and whitespace proof; fixed rejects all five severities without nonblank proof. Nonblank concrete proof passes at all severities; critical/high remain DO-NOT-SHIP and medium/low/info SHIP.
findings.correction_scope: The original defect remains confirmed; FIXED describes only the proposed revision on exercised boundaries.

scope: One independent correction verification wave of six supplied claims; not a full finder campaign.
